description: This file defines an interface for reading the history of standing instructions within the Fineract project. It declares a method to retrieve all standing instruction history data based on a given instruction DTO, and references data classes and a Page class.

classes.name: StandingInstructionHistoryReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for reading standing instruction history data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of standing instruction history data based on the provided DTO.
